tools.name: open_chat_sidebar
tools.description: Open the visible mobile sidebar so navigation and conversation history are available.

tools.name: open_conversation
tools.description: Navigate the mobile shell to another conversation by conversation id.

conversationId.description: Conversation id to open, for example chat-935341cf.

tools.name: scroll_to_conversation_message
tools.description: Scroll the visible transcript to a message by turn id. If no turn id is provided, scroll to the latest visible message.

turnId.description: The DOM turn id to scroll to, for example turn-042.

tools.name: submit_conversation_message
tools.description: Submit a new message through the visible mobile ChatGPT composer. The page visibly navigates through the same form post flow a user would use.

prompt.description: The message text to place in the composer and submit.

tools.name: submitQuery
tools.description: Submit a query through the visible mobile ChatGPT composer and return once the normal conversation submission flow has started.

query.description: The query to place in the composer and submit.
